gloss: natural leader; the type who looks after others

definitions.explanation: The character of someone who naturally takes charge and looks after the people under them, generously and a little paternalistically. Usually said with approval.

examples.japanese: {親分肌|おやぶんはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧。
examples.english: A natural leader who looks after people.
